title: Multi-Model Machine Learning Consensus Identifies a Dual-Interferon Gene Signature in Ischemic Stroke
description:
Code and derived results for a multi-model consensus framework for single-cell biomarker discovery in ischemic stroke.

Eight machine learning models spanning classical (logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost), hybrid (CNN+XGBoost) and transformer-inspired (scGPT, scBERT, scFormer, Geneformer) architectures are trained on mouse MCAO single-cell RNA-seq data (GEO GSE174574; 6 animals, 54,599 cells) under a strict subject-wise train/test split. Gene-level importance is recovered from PCA space by back-projection through the loadings matrix. Genes selected by at least four of the six interpretable models form a 63-gene consensus signature enriched for Type I and Type II interferon response genes, including Il1rn, the target of the FDA-approved drug Anakinra.

Raw sequencing data are not included; they are publicly available at NCBI GEO under accession GSE174574.
